sv.title: Straffar United-fans för inkastade tennisbollar
sv.summary: Fyra Manchester United-supportrar straffas av klubben för att ha kastat in tennisbollar på planen under Champions League-mötet med Roma. Minst en av personerna stängs av från Old Trafford i tre år.

en.title: Four Manchester United fans punished for throwing tennis balls onto the pitch
en.summary: Four Manchester United supporters are being punished by the club for throwing tennis balls onto the pitch during the Champions League match against Roma. At least one of the individuals is banned from Old Trafford for three years.
